questionText: Does Spring Boot replace Spring Framework or wrap it?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can explain that Boot bootstraps and conditionally configures a Framework application and can trace ownership across Boot, Framework, and Spring Data.
outOfScope: Guaranteeing every auto-configuration backs off identically

claims.statement: SpringApplication prepares and refreshes an appropriate Spring ApplicationContext, while Spring Framework remains responsible for bean creation and dependency injection.
Boot auto-configuration is conditional, and defaults guarded by a missing-bean condition back off when the application supplies the relevant bean.

examples.title: Framework service and transaction APIs with a Spring Data repository and Boot infrastructure

validation.expected: The example labels the owner of each API and describes user-bean backoff conditionally

visuals.title: SpringApplication, auto-configuration, and Framework container responsibilities

notes: The earlier false claim that a custom DataSource necessarily collides with an auto-configured bean was corrected.

review.notes: Boot lifecycle and conditional-default claims were checked against the pinned reference; final example fixture and editorial review remain open.
